name: town.mr.vrsl-urp
description: Realtime stage lighting and raymarched beams for Unity 6000.4+ and URP 17.4+, driven by DMX or AudioLink. Adds its render passes at runtime and leaves your URP asset and renderer alone. Installs beside com.acchosen.vr-stage-lighting: asset GUIDs, shader names and runtime globals don't collide.

samples.description: Editor utility and synthetic DMX source for benchmarking the realtime light path. Builds a deterministic profiling scene with N matched fixtures, a fixed-pose camera, and a CRT-bypass DMX source so frame-to-frame variance is controlled.
